rate_table_note: Rates are from the credit life table on page 2 of the memo (joint life is 175% of single). Old rates not recorded: the memo for January 1, 2020 was not found.
summary: The Ohio Department of Insurance's triennial review under rule 3901-1-14 increased the credit life prima facie rates 8.2%, effective January 1, 2023, to $0.678 per $1,000 per month on the outstanding balance and $0.44 per $100 single premium for 12 months. Companies using prima facie rates need not refile.
